notes: Harriet Street lies on the west paper edge: only its east building line (x~233) and water pipe (x~210) are on the sheet; its centreline (~x 166 if 40') is just off the paper (edge ~x 180), so its crossings are NOT recorded here (estimates: W 6th ~(166,438), Sloo ~(166,1152), W Front ~(166,1955); they are on sheet 17). Freeman's east building line is off the paper too; its centre is taken as west building line (x~3766) + 30 ft. Carr Street crosses W 6th (continues north) and ends at W Front; 'THE BARRETT COMPANY' printed along its west side is the property name. Sloo (40') is in two pieces on the same alignment: Harriet to the railroad spur, and Carr to Freeman (T at both). The alley is printed 'SIBLEY (SLOO) ALLEY', 12'. Sargent (45') runs Carr to Freeman, T at both. W Front's south side is railroad land; its centre is taken as north building line + 33 ft (two water pipes run along it); it curves gently between Harriet and Freeman (bends listed). Freeman ends at W Front (T); the junction continues on sheet 19 (W 5th and the SE leg of W Front).
